t: Forging AI's Eyes: A Collaborative Debugging Saga
s: This article details a collaborative debugging session between a human developer and an AI, focusing on resolving Python async/await TypeErrors. It explores the 'tick-tock' development cycle of LLMs, the importance of computing sovereignty, the WET philosophy, and AI as an endosymbiont.
sub: AI Development 'Tick-Tock' Cycle (LLM Scaling vs. New Architectures)
WET Philosophy (Write Everything Twice) vs. DRY for AI Collaboration
AI as an 'Endosymbiont' for Software Development (Iterative Debugging)
Python async/await TypeError Resolution with AST Validation Tooling
